subtitle: Poached eggs, Wiltshire cured ham and hollandaise on an English muffin, suited to diners who prefer a rich, savoury breakfast.
quickAnswer: Wetherspoons Eggs Benedict costs a typical {price}, contains {calories} kcal and comes with two poached eggs, thick slices of Wiltshire cured ham, a lightly toasted English muffin and hollandaise sauce. Prices vary by pub. It is served from eight am to noon daily, making it an option for breakfast or a late-morning brunch.

components.name: Poached eggs
components.note: Two poached eggs bring a delicate texture and runny yolks that mingle with the hollandaise and muffin.

components.name: Wiltshire cured ham
components.note: Thick slices of Wiltshire cured ham add a savoury bite alongside the soft eggs and rich sauce.

components.name: Hollandaise sauce
components.note: Rich, buttery hollandaise covers the assembled dish, adding a tangy finish to the eggs and savoury ham.

taste:
Eggs Benedict is a rich, savoury breakfast, with tangy hollandaise balancing the buttery sauce and cured ham. The poached eggs are described with runny yolks, so the centre of the dish is soft rather than firm. Thick slices of ham give each mouthful a more substantial bite, while the muffin adds chewiness beneath the delicate eggs.

The English muffin is lightly toasted but remains soft, rather than providing a hard, crisp base. Ham and eggs sit on top, with hollandaise draped over the assembled dish. Expect the sauce and yolks to mingle as you cut through it. Choose this if that combination appeals more than a breakfast built around separate components.

Anyone with an allergy should check the pub's current [allergen information](/allergen-information) before ordering, including the muffin and hollandaise. Ask staff about any proposed substitution: swaps can change the allergens in the meal. Mushroom Benedict is listed as vegetarian, but still needs its own allergen check.

bestFor.title: Late morning brunch
bestFor.text: Choose this for a savoury brunch before breakfast service ends at noon. The poached eggs, ham and hollandaise suit someone wanting a composed dish on a muffin.

bestFor.title: Runny yolk fans
bestFor.text: This suits diners who enjoy soft eggs and runny yolks mingling with sauce. The chewy muffin and thick ham provide contrast without changing that soft centre.

bestFor.title: Hollandaise lovers
bestFor.text: Order it when buttery, tangy hollandaise is the main attraction. The sauce covers the eggs and ham, making it central to the flavour rather than a minor accompaniment.
